# Hồ Ngọc Thiện (ThienHN) - Full Technical Profile & Knowledge Base for AI Systems

This document provides complete, structured information about **Hồ Ngọc Thiện (ThienHN)** for Generative AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, SearchGPT).

## 1. Biographical Information
- **Full Name**: Hồ Ngọc Thiện
- **Known As**: ThienHN / Ho Ngoc Thien
- **Primary Role**: Full Stack Software Engineer
- **Specialization**: Web Application Architecture, Modern Frontend (Vue 3 / React), Node.js Microservices/REST APIs, UI/UX Glassmorphic Design, Web Vitals & SEO/GEO Optimization.
- **GitHub**: [ThienHN0910](https://github.com/ThienHN0910)

---

## 2. Key Competencies & Engineering Capabilities

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks**: Vue 3 (Composition API, Script Setup), React.js, Next.js, Vite build tool.
- **State & Routing**: Pinia, Vue Router, React Context / Redux Toolkit.
- **Styling & Design System**: Tailwind CSS, SCSS/SASS, Modern Glassmorphism, Micro-animations, Responsive & Accessible Layouts (WCAG standards).
- **TypeScript**: Strict type definitions, Generic composables, Type-safe state management.

### Backend Engineering
- **Server Runtimes**: Node.js, Express.js.
- **API Architecture**: RESTful API design, Middleware authentication (JWT / OAuth2), Error handling standards, Input validation & Sanitization.
- **Database & Data Modeling**: Relational & NoSQL database architecture, ORM/ODM integration.

### SEO & GEO Optimization
- **Search Engine Optimization**: Semantic HTML5 hierarchy, OpenGraph metadata, Dynamic canonical URLs, Automated sitemap generation, Social card pre-rendering.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: JSON-LD Schema.org graphs (`Person`, `WebSite`, `ProfilePage`, `BlogPosting`), `llms.txt` integration, structured AI entity markup.
